2.15.0: Fixed a problem where conversations you opened could go missing the next time Ion Studio started.
You can now run your Quick Tools and Composer Actions from the + menu on your phone.
2.14.1: Fixed a problem where conversations already being handled did not appear dimmed in your Inbox, making them harder to tell apart from ones still waiting for attention.
2.14.0: When a folder is locked, new conversations open directly into it and options to add or rearrange folders are hidden.
Fixed a problem where you could not choose your own subscription without having administrator access.
Your first conversation now opens automatically when you sign in.
Fixed a problem where tabs that reopened landed in the wrong project.
2.13.2: Fixed a problem where the Inbox did not open by default when you launched Ion Studio for the first time.
You can now attach files and screenshots regardless of how you are accessing Ion Studio.
Fixed a problem where the Inbox showed a sort order as selected even though you had not chosen one.
2.13.1: Fixed a problem where the Inbox showed an app as still running after it had already been closed.
Fixed a problem where terminals running in other Environments were missing from the list, or kept appearing after that Environment disconnected.
2.12.1: Fixed a problem where buttons and panels for features you did not have access to were still visible on screen.
